bootstrap: docker compose up -d postgres || docker run -d --name navin-postgres -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=navin -e POSTGRES_USER=navin -e POSTGRES_DB=app -p 5432:5432 postgres:16-alpine
Wait for pg_isready, then run launch.migrate and launch.seed.
